title: Rav Erez Elcharar Elected
body: Rav Erez Elcharar is the new chief rabbi of Hod HaSharon, elected by a decisive margin of 24 votes. The selection process was prolonged and closely watched.

title: Chareidi Draft Law Falls Short
body: Brig. Gen. Shay Taib, head of the IDF's Planning and Manpower Administration Division, admitted in Knesset that the chareidi draft law won't meet Israel's manpower needs, contradicting political promises.

title: Satmar Rebbe Inspects New Halls
body: Satmar Rebbe Rav Zalman Leib Teitelbaum toured two grand event halls in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, nearing completion for the Satmar community.

title: Rabbis Unite Against Draft Law
body: Dozens of Rabbanim and Rebbes gathered in Yerushalayim to protest the proposed draft law, calling it an existential threat. They announced a mass rally in response.

title: Police Choke Chareidi Protester
body: Violent clashes erupted between police and chareidi demonstrators at the Givat Shmuel junction over the arrest of yeshiva students labeled as draft evaders. Graphic footage shows a police officer striking, choking, and throwing a young chareidi protester.
